title: Hike up Stone Mountain with Houston

tellings.quote: yeah yeah and we hiked up Stone Mountain when we were in Atlanta even Dr Powell came with

plain: In 2023, while filming in Atlanta, the documentary maker Ky Dickens says she hiked up Stone Mountain in Georgia with Houston, one of the people in her film about children said to read minds. She adds that a doctor named Diane Powell came along too. Dickens tells it as something she took part in, a moment from making the film.
